quantization.method: grid = 0.01; a value is off-grid if round(v,2) != v; choice-vs-table mismatch = displayed choice probability < displayed max

confidence_formula.note: chance-corrected top-probability (kappa-style). Residuals of 1-2 display quanta are expected when confidence is computed on the pre-quantization distribution while the table is rounded separately (see quantization audit: choice/table argmax mismatches at exactly one quantum).

marginal_cost.method: marginal latency per question/option (analysis.json) vs the prefill cost of the tokens that unit adds to the request (rows.jsonl usage deltas x prefill slope). residual = everything else (read-out, serialization, noise).

battery_power.method: discriminating information per probe = reported tokens above the empty-template baseline. The short battery's deltas are a few tokens wide; the whitespace-free mergerate samples are one to two orders of magnitude wider.

rotation_pairs.method: pair rotation-audit items to their native-order results by base item id (rotation ids carry a :permN suffix); exact two-sided McNemar on discordant pairs. Wilson CIs in score.json are item-sampling diagnostics.

prefill_shape.method: refit of upstream_ms (x-envoy-upstream-service-time) vs server-reported input tokens; residual check at the longest prompts bounds any attention quadratic. Slopes are scheduling-inclusive marginal costs under shared batching - NOT parameter-count evidence.
